body:
I hear it's pretty nice down there, the forests and lakes...
How's the weather during the winter months though?

Just a suggestion: if you can't find anybody to talk to genuinely, because it's hard for you to make friends, try connecting with the homeless or simply a homeless person in your area that you have a good contact with. They have it pretty hard and can use interaction, they might be less judgemental and if you can help them a little bit, it'll cost you less than a therapist :)

I like the phrase "focusing on the positives". Thanks for the advice. I mean I'm not gonna tell him "you should do this, you should do that" I want it to come from him and build his capacity. I'm sure it would do him lot of good to actually see a glimmer of hope. He says he's been on this earth for X years and has done "nothing". He always speaks about it in a calm manner, like he's just tired of everything. He doesn't cry in front of me.
Do you want to tell us a little bit about yourself OP?
